sourceProjection.basis: Page 1 lower ground-floor plan and both page 2 exhibition floor diagrams were visually inspected as overhead plans. review: PDF p2 visually checked: orthographic exhibit floors. Grey south-east offset paths are printed shadows, excluded. A11 and A12 share one printed area, separate labels retained.
